title: Copernicus STAC Extension
description: Merged STAC extension for Copernicus services, combining 31 STAC extensions under a single copernicus: field prefix.

allOf.$comment: STAC Items: fields in Item Properties, Assets, Links, Bands
STAC Collections and Catalogs: own fields + summaries

copernicus:absolute_orbit.title: Absolute Orbit
copernicus:absolute_orbit.description: The absolute orbit number at the start of acquisition. When the orbit changes during data acquisition (i.e., the acquisition spans multiple orbits), use the absolute orbit number at the start of the acquisition.

copernicus:acquisition_station.description: The acquisition station (ground station) where the satellite data was downlinked. Equivalent to `eop:acquisition_station` in OGC 10-157r4 and OGC 17-003r2.

copernicus:acquisition_type.description: The acquisition type of the product.

allOf.$comment: Require href in alternate assets in normal assets

copernicus:alternate.description: Alternate asset locations keyed by provider name, each an Asset Object without href.

copernicus:alternate_name.description: A human readable name for the alternate asset.

copernicus:anx_datetime.description: The [Ascending Node](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orbital_node) Crossing (ANX) time, in UTC. It is formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6).

copernicus:auth_refs.description: The names of authentication schemes (keys of copernicus:auth_schemes) that apply to an asset or link.

copernicus:auth_schemes.description: Dictionary of named authentication schemes that guard access to assets or links.

copernicus:azimuth.title: Azimuth angle
copernicus:azimuth.description: Viewing azimuth angle. The angle measured from the sub-satellite point (point on the ground below the platform) between the scene center and true north. Measured clockwise from north in degrees (0-360).

copernicus:bandwidth.title: Range Bandwidth (GHz)
copernicus:bandwidth.description: The range bandwidth of the SAR instrument, in gigahertz (GHz), representing the full bandwidth used in range compression and image formation.

copernicus:bbox.title: Extent
copernicus:bbox.description: Bounding box of the Item in the asset CRS in 2 or 3 dimensions.

copernicus:beam_ids.title: Beam identifiers
copernicus:beam_ids.description: Composition of the swath of the SAR acquision referencing the beam identifiers.

copernicus:bitfields.description: Classes stored in bit fields in the raster

copernicus:bits_per_sample.title: The actual number of bits used for this band
copernicus:bits_per_sample.description: The actual number of bits used for this band. Normally only present when the number of bits is non-standard for the `datatype`, such as when a 1 bit TIFF is represented as byte.

copernicus:center_frequency.title: Center Frequency (GHz)
copernicus:center_frequency.description: RECOMMENDED. The center frequency of the radar signal transmitted by the instrument, in gigahertz (GHz).

copernicus:center_wavelength.title: Center Wavelength
copernicus:center_wavelength.description: The center wavelength of the band, in micrometers (μm).

copernicus:centroid.title: Centroid
copernicus:centroid.description: Coordinates representing the centroid of the Item (in lat/long)

copernicus:chip_size.description: Chip size in pixels as `[height, width]`.

copernicus:citation.title: Proposed Data Citation
copernicus:citation.description: The recommended human-readable reference (citation) to be used by publications citing the data. No specific citation style is suggested, but the citation should contain all information required to find the publication distinctively.

copernicus:classes.description: Classes stored in raster or bands

copernicus:cloud_cover.title: Cloud Cover
copernicus:cloud_cover.description: Estimate of cloud cover as a percentage (0-100).

copernicus:columns.description: A list of Column Objects describing each column.

copernicus:common_name.title: Common Name of the band
copernicus:common_name.description: The name commonly used to refer to the band to make it easier to search for bands across instruments. See the [list of accepted common names](#common-band-names).

copernicus:contacts.description: **REQUIRED.** A list of contacts qualified by their role.

copernicus:country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Two-letter country code for the country that is primarily covered by the data.

copernicus:datastrip_id.title: Datastrip ID
copernicus:datastrip_id.description: The identifier of the datastrip, i.e. the part of a datatake that the ground segment processed as one unit. See [Datastrip ID](#datastrip-id) for details.

copernicus:datatake_id.title: Unique Datatake Identifier
copernicus:datatake_id.description: Datatake identification. Examples: for S1, datatake_id = 12032; for S2, datatake_id = GS2A_20231215T103431_044292_N05.10

copernicus:datetime.title: Processing Datetime
copernicus:datetime.description: Processing date and time of the corresponding data formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6), in UTC.

copernicus:dimensions.description: **REQUIRED.** Uniquely named dimensions of the datacube.

copernicus:doi.title: Data DOI
copernicus:doi.description: The DOI of the data, e.g. `10.1000/xyz123`. This MUST NOT be a DOIs link. For all DOI names respective DOI links SHOULD be added to the links section (see chapter "Relation types").

copernicus:embedding_dimensions.description: **REQUIRED**. Embedding dimensions as an array of sizes, e.g. `[768]` for a single 768-dimensional vector.

copernicus:expires.title: Expiry Time
copernicus:expires.description: Date and time the corresponding data (see below) expires (is not valid any longer), in UTC.

copernicus:expression.title: Processing Expression

expression.description: Any data type, depending on the format chosen.

copernicus:expression.description: An expression or processing chain that describes how the data has been processed. Alternatively, you can also link to a processing chain with the relation type `processing-expression` (see below).

copernicus:facility.title: Processing Facility
examples: Copernicus S1 Core Ground Segment - DPA
copernicus:facility.description: The name of the facility that produced the data. For example, `Copernicus S1 Core Ground Segment - DPA` for product of Sentinel-1 satellites.

copernicus:frequency_band.title: Frequency Band
copernicus:frequency_band.description: RECOMMENDED. The common name for the frequency band to make it easier to search for bands across instruments. See section "Common Frequency Band Names" for a list of accepted names.

copernicus:full_width_half_max.title: Full Width Half Max (FWHM)
copernicus:full_width_half_max.description: Full width at half maximum (FWHM). The width of the band, as measured at half the maximum transmission, in micrometers (μm).

copernicus:geometry.description: Defines the footprint of this Item.

copernicus:geometry_types.description: A list of the geometry types present in the dataset.

copernicus:grid_code.description: **REQUIRED**. The identifier for the grid element associated with the Item.

copernicus:grid_id.description: Grid system the chips are aligned to. See [Grid IDs](#grid-ids).

copernicus:histogram.title: Histogram

items.title: number of pixels in the bucket

copernicus:histogram.description: Histogram distribution information of the pixels values in the band.

copernicus:incidence_angle.title: Center incidence angle
copernicus:incidence_angle.description: The incidence angle is the angle between the vertical (normal) to the intercepting surface and the line of sight back to the satellite at the scene center. Measured in degrees (0-90).

copernicus:instrument_configuration_id.title: Instrument Configuration Identifier
copernicus:instrument_configuration_id.description: The instrument configuration ID is specific to S1 SAR instrument and refers to the onboard configuration. Each version of it has a specific identifier called "Instrument Configuration ID" (ICID) corresponding to a specific number. For more information, cf. ["What is the instrument configuration ID (ICID) ?"](https://sar-mpc.eu/about/faq/)

copernicus:instrument_mode.description: Mode of the altimetry instrument used to collect the data.

copernicus:instrument_type.description: Type of altimetry instrument used to collect the data.

copernicus:level.title: Processing Level
copernicus:level.description: The name commonly used to refer to the processing level to make it easier to search for product level across collections or items. The short name must be used (only `L`, not `Level`). See the [list of suggested processing levels](#suggested-processing-levels).

copernicus:lineage.title: Processing Lineage Information
copernicus:lineage.description: Lineage Information provided as free text information about the how observations were processed or models that were used to create the resource being described [NASA ISO](https://wiki.earthdata.nasa.gov/display/NASAISO/Lineage+Information). For example, `GRD Post Processing` for "GRD" product of Sentinel-1 satellites. [CommonMark 0.29](https://commonmark.org/) syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

copernicus:looks_azimuth.title: Looks azimuth
copernicus:looks_azimuth.description: Number of azimuth looks, which is the number of groups of signal samples (looks) parallel to the flight path.

copernicus:looks_range.title: Looks range
copernicus:looks_range.description: Number of range looks, which is the number of groups of signal samples (looks) perpendicular to the flight path.

copernicus:mmu.description: Minimum Mapping Unit - the smallest polygon area represented.

copernicus:mmw.description: Minimal Mapping Width - the smallest real-world width represented as polygon.

copernicus:moon_azimuth.title: Moon Azimuth
copernicus:moon_azimuth.description: Moon azimuth angle. From the scene center point on the ground, this is the angle between truth north and the moon. Measured clockwise in degrees (0-360).

copernicus:moon_elevation.title: Moon Elevation
copernicus:moon_elevation.description: Moon elevation angle. The angle from the tangent of the scene center point to the moon. Measured from the horizon in degrees (`0`-`90`).

copernicus:name.description: A human-readable name of the relevant region.

copernicus:nominal_track.description: An array of coordinates used to define the nominal track on the earths surface. This value is recommended ONLY if the item geometry is not representative of the acquisition track.

copernicus:observation_direction.title: Antenna pointing direction
copernicus:observation_direction.description: Antenna pointing direction relative to the flight trajectory of the satellite, either `left` or `right`.

copernicus:off_nadir.title: Off Nadir
copernicus:off_nadir.description: The angle from the sensor between nadir (straight down) and the scene center. Measured in degrees (0-90).

copernicus:offset.title: number to be added to the pixel value to transform into the value
copernicus:offset.description: Number to be added to the pixel value (after scaling) to transform into the value (i.e. translate digital number to reflectance).

copernicus:open_kwargs.description: Keyword arguments to provide to the xarray opener

copernicus:orbit_cycle.description: The number of repeat cycle done by the satellite at the time of the acquisition. [Repeat cycle](https://ltb.itc.utwente.nl/page/498/concept/81577) is the time between two successive identical orbits.

copernicus:orbit_state.title: Orbit State
copernicus:orbit_state.description: The state of the orbit. Either `ascending` or `descending` for polar orbiting satellites, `geostationary` for geosynchronous satellites, or `crossing` when the acquisition spans a polar crossing.

copernicus:orbit_state_vectors.$comment: The key is a date-time string, and the value is an array of numbers.
copernicus:orbit_state_vectors.description: The state vectors of the satellite at the time of acquisition.

copernicus:order_date.description: Indicates the order submission time, in UTC and formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6).

copernicus:order_expiration_date.description: **DEPRECATED.** Indicates the validity time of the order, in UTC and formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). Use [`expires` from the timestamps extension](https://github.com/stac-extensions/timestamps/) instead.

copernicus:order_status.description: **REQUIRED**. Describe the status of the ordering. One of the value listed [here](#orderstatus)

copernicus:origin_datetime.title: Origin Date Time
copernicus:origin_datetime.description: Date time of the input data considered to create the item. Example: for PRIP, time of the availability of all CADU data on the CADIP/XBIP

copernicus:original_data_type.description: Data type before quantization. Uses the same [data type values](https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/master/commons/common-metadata.md#data-types) as `data_type`.

copernicus:pixel_spacing_azimuth.title: Pixel spacing azimuth (m)
copernicus:pixel_spacing_azimuth.description: The azimuth pixel spacing, which is the distance between adjacent pixels parallel to the flight path, in meters (m). Strongly RECOMMENDED to be specified for products of type `GRD`.

copernicus:pixel_spacing_range.title: Pixel spacing range (m)
copernicus:pixel_spacing_range.description: The range pixel spacing, which is the distance between adjacent pixels perpendicular to the flight path, in meters (m). Strongly RECOMMENDED to be specified for products of type `GRD`.

copernicus:platform_international_design.description: The International Designator, also known as COSPAR ID, and NSSDCA ID

copernicus:product_status.$comment: The value 'qualitydegraded' is deprecated. Use 'product:quality_status' with the value 'degraded' instead.

copernicus:projjson.title: Coordinate Reference System in PROJJSON format

copernicus:publications.title: Publications
copernicus:publications.description: List of relevant publications referencing and describing the data.

copernicus:published.title: Publish Time
copernicus:published.description: Date and time the corresponding data (see below) was published the first time, in UTC.

copernicus:quality_status.description: The quality status of the product: `nominal` or `degraded`.

copernicus:relative_burst.title: Relative burst number
copernicus:relative_burst.description: Identification number that uniquely identifies a burst cycle within each repeat cycle.

copernicus:relative_orbit.title: Relative Orbit
copernicus:relative_orbit.description: The relative orbit number at the start of acquisition. When the orbit changes during data acquisition (i.e., the acquisition spans multiple orbits), use the relative orbit number at the start of the acquisition.

copernicus:renders.title: Renders
copernicus:renders.description: Dictionary of rendering instructions keyed by a unique render name.

additionalProperties.$comment: Add your new fields here. Don't require them here, do that above in the corresponding schema.

copernicus:resolution_azimuth.title: Resolution azimuth (m)
copernicus:resolution_azimuth.description: The azimuth resolution, which is the maximum ability to distinguish two adjacent targets parallel to the flight path, in meters (m).

copernicus:resolution_range.title: Resolution range (m)
copernicus:resolution_range.description: The range resolution, which is the maximum ability to distinguish two adjacent targets perpendicular to the flight path, in meters (m).

copernicus:row_count.description: The number of rows in the dataset.

copernicus:sampling.title: Pixel sampling in the band
copernicus:sampling.description: One of `area` or `point`. Indicates whether a pixel value should be assumed to represent a sampling over the region of the pixel or a point sample at the center of the pixel.

copernicus:sampling_rate.description: Sampling rate of the altimetry instrument in Hz.

copernicus:scale.title: multiplicator factor of the pixel value to transform into the value
copernicus:scale.description: Multiplicator factor of the pixel value to transform into the value (i.e. translate digital number to reflectance).

copernicus:season.description: The VPP season number. One of `S1` or `S2`. See below for details.

copernicus:servers.description: The servers to substitute for the {s} variable in the link href.

copernicus:shape.title: Shape
copernicus:shape.description: Number of pixels in Y and X directions for the default grid

copernicus:snow_cover.title: Snow and Ice Cover
copernicus:snow_cover.description: Estimate of snow and ice cover as a percentage (0-100).

copernicus:software.title: Processing Software Name / version
copernicus:software.description: A dictionary with name/version for key/value describing one or more applications or libraries that were involved during the production of the data for provenance purposes.

copernicus:solar_illumination.title: Solar Illumination
copernicus:solar_illumination.description: The solar illumination of the band, as measured at half the maximum transmission, in W/m2/micrometers.

copernicus:spatial_resolution.title: Average spatial resolution (in meters) of the pixels in the band
copernicus:spatial_resolution.description: Average spatial resolution (in meters) of the pixels in the band.

copernicus:stats_catalogs.description: A lookup of statistics for all child catalogs.

copernicus:stats_collections.description: A lookup of statistics for all child collections.

copernicus:stats_items.description: A lookup of statistics for all child items.

copernicus:storage_options.description: **DEPRECATED** Additional keywords for opening the dataset.

copernicus:stride.description: Step between the origins of neighboring chips in pixels as `[row_stride, col_stride]`. When `stride < chip_size`, chips overlap.

copernicus:sub_parameter.description: The VPP sub-parameter acronym. See below for the list of allowed values.

copernicus:subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 codes for identifying the principal subdivisions (e.g., provinces or states) of a country that is primarily covered by the data. Only provide the second part of the ISO 3166-2 code to reduce redundancy.

copernicus:sun_azimuth.title: Sun Azimuth
copernicus:sun_azimuth.description: Sun azimuth angle. From the scene center point on the ground, this is the angle between truth north and the sun. Measured clockwise in degrees (0-360).

copernicus:sun_elevation.title: Sun Elevation
copernicus:sun_elevation.description: Sun elevation angle. The angle from the tangent of the scene center point to the sun. Measured from the horizon in degrees (`-90`-`90`). Negative values indicate the sun is below the horizon, e.g. sun elevation of -10° means the data was captured during [nautical twilight](https://www.timeanddate.com/astronomy/different-types-twilight.html).

copernicus:tables.description: **DEPRECATED** A list of Table Objects (see below).

copernicus:themes.description: **REQUIRED.** A knowledge organization system used to classify the STAC entity. Each element is a concept and their respective knowledge organization system / controlled vocabulary.

copernicus:timeliness.description: The average expected timeliness of the product as an [ISO 8601 Duration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Durations).

copernicus:timeliness_category.description: A proprietary category identifier for the timeliness of the product.

copernicus:transform.title: Transform
copernicus:transform.description: The affine transformation coefficients for the default grid

copernicus:unpublished.title: Removal Time
copernicus:unpublished.description: Date and time the corresponding data (see below) was unpublished, in UTC.

copernicus:variables.description: Uniquely named variables of the datacube.

copernicus:version.title: Processing Version
copernicus:version.description: The version of the primary processing software or processing chain that produced the data. For example, this could be the processing baseline for the Sentinel missions.

copernicus:wkt2.title: Coordinate Reference System in WKT2 format

copernicus:wms_transparent.description: Whether the WMS map background is transparent.

copernicus:wmts_encoding.description: The encoding to use for WMTS requests: `rest` or `kvp`.

auth:refs.title: Keys of schemes in auth:schemes that may supply this scheme's input (any one of them is completed first; its result is this scheme's input, e.g. the subject_token of a tokenExchange flow)

name.title: API Key header, query, or cookie parameter name

scheme.title: Name of the http authentication scheme

openIdConnectUrl.title: This URL returns a JSON listing of the OpenID/OAuth endpoints, supported scopes and claims, public keys used to sign the tokens, and other details

allOf.$comment: A tokenExchange flow consumes another scheme's token: the scheme must reference at least one scheme; the token obtained through whichever one the client uses is the RFC 8693 subject_token.

authorizationUrl.title: The authorization URL to be used

tokenUrl.title: The token URL to be used

subjectTokenType.title: RFC 8693 subject_token_type URN of the token presented at the tokenUrl (tokenExchange flow)

refreshUrl.title: The URL to be used for obtaining refresh tokens

scopes.title: The available scopes for the authentication scheme

authorizationApi.title: The signed URL API endpoint to be used

responseField.title: Key name for the signed URL field in an authorizationApi response

parameters.title: Parameter definitions for requests to the authorizationApi

required.title: Setting for optional or required parameter

description.title: Plain language description of the parameter

nodata.$comment: The schema is from common metadata, see https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/v1.1.0/item-spec/json-schema/data-values.json

data_type.$comment: The schema is from common metadata, see https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/v1.1.0/item-spec/json-schema/data-values.json
